Scope and provenance
--------------------
This permission covers this package's newly specified scores, local synthesis
source, resulting WAV/Ogg/MP3 recordings, and accompanying documentation.
The scores and code were AI-authored for the Dormi project; sounds are entirely
procedural synthetic instruments. There are no external samples, soundfonts,
commercial recordings, borrowed tune transcriptions, or downloaded melodies.
The contributor grants any rights it may have; this does not assert human
authorship, exclusivity, or the availability of copyright protection for
AI-generated material. Ordinary chord shapes and musical devices can also
occur in other music. No music-catalog similarity search has been performed.

Python, NumPy, SciPy, FFmpeg, and codec implementations are separate tools,
not included in this package; their own licenses apply to those tools.
